rows.name: Hired Thug

target.source: user, 2026-11-12: Hired Thugs down to Blooded

rows.note: the Hired Thugs borrow their level from the bandit chiefs: each takes `Stats`, `Traits` and `Inventory` from a chief wrapper, which takes them from `LCharBanditBoss` 03DF16, `LCharBanditBossCommonerM` 01A33A or `LCharBanditBossNordM` 01A341 (*Bandit Chiefs*), so they roll the boss ladder and its gear. Changing that ladder changes them. Moved here from Uncategorised → *Bandit Level Borrowers* (user, 2026-10-04).

items: No record uses a Hired Thug as its template. The records that keep their own level beside the boss ladder (the CC Bounty Hunter, Kyr, Fjola, the `WEDL05` Thug, Salma, Umbra) are listed on *Bandit Chiefs*.
All three records carry `Stats` and follow their chief wrapper.

rows.note: the Hired Thugs are created by quest aliases; the chief lists only lend the level (*Bandit Chiefs*)
